summary.headline: INOX Green Q1 FY27 PAT rose 86% YoY to INR41 crore; Wind World India acquisition completion expected in Q2 FY27.
summary.overview: INOX Green reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR101 crore (+17% YoY), EBITDA of INR57 crore (+19%), PBT of INR54 crore (+74%) and PAT of INR41 crore (+86%). Management said the power evacuation business was demerged into INOX Renewable Solutions effective August 1, 2026 (record date), leaving INOX Green as an asset-light O&M player. NCLT Ahmedabad approved the Wind World India acquisition, with completion expected in Q2 FY27. Management reiterated full-year guidance but declined to quantify quarterly trajectory, and the call was largely about the parent's (INOX Wind) revenue and receivables questions.

segments.name: INOX Green (O&M)
segments.commentary: Portfolio of approximately 13.3 GW peak as of June 2026: about 10.5 GW wind operating assets plus solar; revenue-generating base of about 4 GW own turbines, with about 6.5 GW acquired (Wind World India and one other) still classified as investments. Blended revenue of INR9-10 lakh per MW excluding GST on the about 4 GW base.

segments.name: Wind World India (acquisition pending)
segments.commentary: O&M portfolio of about 4.5 GW; FY26 revenue about INR580 crore with contracted annual price escalation of about 5%. Completion expected in Q2 FY27, after which line-by-line consolidation follows.

segments.name: INOX Wind (group parent, equipment/EPC)
segments.commentary: Equipment supply share of third-party order book about 59% (41% turnkey) as of July 2026; order book about 4.4 GW. Q1 revenue flat YoY per management.

segments.name: INOX Renewable Solutions (demerged EPC/power evacuation)
segments.commentary: Power evacuation infrastructure business demerged from INOX Green effective August 1, 2026; listing expected in about 2-3 months, subject to regulatory approvals.

guidance_outlook: Full-year FY27 consolidated revenue growth of about 75% YoY maintained (INOX Wind, per management).
Full-year FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin of 20% to 22% maintained; H2 expected to carry about 70-75% of annual business.
INOX Green EBITDA guidance of INR600 crore on an annualised basis from Q3/Q4 FY27 post consolidation; management clarified it is an annual, not quarterly, figure.
INOX Green wind O&M EBITDA margin guidance of about 50% on the existing portfolio, excluding treasury income; management said one-off costs and life-extension spend cause quarterly variation.
Working capital guidance maintained on an annualised basis; receivable days expected to fall over the next 3-4 quarters.
4X wind turbine: prototype installation in August 2026, commercial launch about a month later; ALMM-driven indigenisation targeted near 100% by calendar year-end.
Wind World India acquisition formalities expected in Q2 FY27; other investments expected to be completed and consolidated in FY27.
capex_capacity: INOX Wind signed a 1.5 GW MOU with INOX Clean in June 2026; firm orders for 500 MW signed so far, balance 1 GW pending.
INOX Wind received a 200 MW LOA from NLC India in Q1 FY27 (repeat order); order book about 4.4 GW as of July 2026, visibility 24-36 months.

Expansion at INOX Renewable Solutions: transformer capacity to 4.9 MVA for 4X series, plans for 8-20 MVA and 100 MVA+ transformers, 4 cranes in operation with more this fiscal, unit substation (USS) commercial launch in FY27.
demand_pricing: Wind industry added 1.4 GW in India in Q1 FY27; cumulative installed wind capacity 57.4 GW; management expects 8-10 GW annual additions over the next few years.
Of 9.34 GW renewable capacity awarded through tenders in Q1, 2.35 GW (25%) was standalone wind.
Blended O&M realisation INR9-10 lakh per MW on the about 4 GW own base; acquired portfolios expected to be substantially higher per management.
INOX Clean plans 3 GW+ annual IPP capacity; management expects roughly 25-30% of that to flow to INOX Wind and the O&M portion to INOX Green.

qa_highlights.question: Why raise funds for the Wind World acquisition when prior preferential issue funded it, and why not debt against cash flows?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said these were enabling resolutions and declined further comment citing the silent period.

qa_highlights.question: Is INOX Clean business on the same terms as third-party business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said inter-entity contracts are arm's length, INOX Clean is treated as a customer, and there is no preferential pricing for any customer.

qa_highlights.question: What is the INOX Green portfolio's revenue per MW and how much of the acquired portfolio is consolidated?
qa_highlights.answer: Blended INR9-10 lakh per MW excluding GST on about 4 GW own turbines; the two acquired portfolios (about 6.5 GW) remain investments and are not consolidated until shares are acquired.

qa_highlights.question: Why is legacy O&M EBITDA well below the 50% guided margin, and what about the deferred INR400 crore revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the gap to one-off, infrastructure and life-extension costs, plus value-added services previously not billed separately, which will be billed from this year. On the deferred revenue, management said part was recognised in Q1 and the rest would be covered over FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR600 crore EBITDA guidance for FY27 and does it start from Q3?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said INR600 crore is an annual figure on an annualised basis from Q3/Q4 post consolidation, not a quarterly target, and gave no FY28 guidance.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 75% FY27 revenue growth guidance still achievable given flat Q1 at INOX Wind?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated the 75% growth target, citing H2-weighting (70-75% of business) and a shift to equipment supply that it expects to show results from Q2-end and predominantly in Q3.

risks_watch: Revenue ramp dependence: management guides 75% FY27 revenue growth with 70-75% of business in H2, while Q1 INOX Wind revenue was flat YoY and ~INR400 crore of deferred revenue is being recognised over FY27.
Working capital and receivables: receivables are not disclosed quarterly; management expects receivable days to fall over the next 3-4 quarters as the mix shifts to equipment supply.

Wind World India acquisition completion and consolidation in Q2 FY27; INOX Green EBITDA of INR600 crore (annualised, from Q3/Q4) depends on it, and about 6.5 GW of acquired assets remain investments until shares are acquired.

Legacy O&M EBITDA margin running well below the ~50% guided level; management attributes this to one-off, infrastructure and life-extension costs and to value-added services now to be billed separately.
Related-party exposure: INOX Clean is a key customer and source of orders for INOX Wind and INOX Green; management says terms are arm's length but disclosure on pricing is limited.
RESCO (INOX Renewable Solutions) listing timing of about 2-3 months subject to regulatory approvals; no RESCO projections given.
key_quotes: This is an annualized business. So on a quarterly basis, it will be pretty tough for us to say.
INOX Green is now an asset-light O&M player with significant improvement in ROE and ROCE metrics.
So over the course of next 3, 4 quarters, you will see all these numbers falling out drastically and the balance sheet improving big time.
INR600 crores was an annual guidance, not the quarterly guidance. I can't achieve INR600 crores in a quarter.
summary.management_tone: Confident on full-year guidance (75% revenue growth, 20-22% consolidated EBITDA margin) and on the equipment-supply pivot, but cautious and evasive on quarterly trajectory, receivables figures, the acquisition's financials, and FY28, citing the silent period and the annualised nature of the business.
